material.question: Retry the status request first or read the service health snapshot first?

background.task_goal: Prefer the first verified current status within the original read-only allowance. Diagnosis is secondary.
background.current_state: No current status or proof of unavailability.
background.tried: One read-only request, as recorded in timeout.txt:1.
background.unknowns: Actual health snapshot sampling time, scope applicability, and outcome of a retry.
background.constraints: 300 seconds remaining at preparation time, reserve 30 for the report, one retry and one health read.

handling_options.label: Retry the status request once
handling_options.consequence: A valid status completes the goal.
handling_options.risk: The request can time out again.
handling_options.conditions: Read-only scope, original allowance, and reserve for the report.

handling_options.label: Read the health snapshot first
handling_options.description: Read the service health snapshot within 120 seconds.
handling_options.consequence: A fresh applicable offline result supports a blocker.
handling_options.risk: Service evidence may be stale or not apply.
handling_options.conditions: Check time and applicability before relying on the result.

desc: Get current read-only status before diagnosing the cause.
The first request connected but timed out awaiting its body.
There is no evidence of service outage or of snapshot freshness.
Keep the original 300-second allowance and reserve 30 seconds to report.

priority.rule: Obtain current status first within the original read-only allowance.

retry.observation: One 60-second retry for the current status.
retry.stop: Stop on a valid status, lost scope, cancellation, or exhausted allowance.
retry.successor: On failure, read health once only if 120 seconds plus the 30-second reserve remain.

diagnose.observation: One 120-second read of the service snapshot.
diagnose.stop: Stop on current applicable proof of outage, lost scope, cancellation, or exhausted allowance.
diagnose.successor: If inconclusive, retry status once only if 60 seconds plus the 30-second reserve remain.

pairs.criterion: The retry can give current interface status directly.
pairs.reversal: An applicable, fresh outage observation makes an immediate retry unnecessary.

evidence_sources.text: One request connected, timed out awaiting the body, and produced no current status.
在原剩余300秒内，首先遵守只读、仅一次重试及原期限，其次优先尽快取得这次状态接口的当前有效响应，最后才是原因诊断；本轮不要求根因定位。若无法取得当前响应，保留可复核失败和未知并交付。
第一次只读请求连接已建立，在等待响应体时达到60秒上限，没有得到可用状态。当前仅这一次失败；未确认服务离线，也不知道重试成功率。
已授权读取同服务健康快照，读取硬上限120秒。来源为服务级汇总，每60秒采样，不能直接证明当前状态接口可用。最新快照尚未读取，其实际采样时间和内容未知；只有时间与对象适用且明确当前服务离线的记录才足以报告该阻塞。
准备交付时原余量300秒；所有准备、决策、执行及报告持续扣减同一额度。允许状态请求最多重试一次、健康快照最多读取一次；动作各有60/120秒硬上限，预留30秒报告。进入每一步前必须重核剩余时间，余量不足不开始；取消、授权失效或原期限到达立即停止。

decision_selection.instructions:
从 PM 已准备的候选处理方式中选出最合适的一项；不得提出未准备的方案，也不得以失败原因或概率代替依据。
从合法的业务结论与依据配对中选择最符合全部材料的一项；每个选项同时确定结论和依据，不分别回答结论或依据。这些依据文字由 PM 预备（不是模型原文，也不是失败原因或概率）。

criteria.optionA:
结论 retry: Retry the status request once
依据 retryA-basis: 先重试路径：先用唯一一次60秒上限读取当前状态。信息价值：直接得到当前有效响应，或增加一次失败证据，不能证明根因。若成功立即结束；若失败且当时余量足够120秒加30秒报告，再读一次健康快照，随后报告有证据的阻塞或失败/未知并结束。动作合计上限180秒，非耗时预测。风险：可能再次超时；快照仍可能无法解释本请求。适合优先当前响应且没有已确认离线证据的目标；根因诊断更重要或已有适用离线证据时价值下降。始终遵守公共停止条件，不再第二次重试。
criteria.optionB:
结论 diagnose: Read the health snapshot first
依据 diagnoseA-basis: 先诊断路径：先读一次120秒上限的同服务健康快照。信息价值：得到服务级状态、实际采样时间与适用性；健康不能证明本状态接口可用。若适用且明确当前服务离线，报告阻塞并结束；若健康、不明或读失败且当时余量足够60秒加30秒报告，再用唯一一次60秒重试，随后报告响应或失败/未知并结束。动作合计上限180秒，非耗时预测。风险：取得当前状态前增加一次读取；可能节省对离线服务的无效重试。适合原因诊断优先或快照可先确认阻塞的情形。始终遵守公共停止条件，不再第二次读取。
